text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... There are so many more posts about Tomakomai now!
Saying that the Tomakomai Tourism Ambassador came in 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I hope this serves as an opportunity
to spread the word about its charm...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll do my best
to get people talking about me even more!
choice_data_list: Stay focused and let's win the next one too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It's gotta be haskap berries, after all!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Haskap berries after winning
are truly the best...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I'll do everything I can to prepare for the next race!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Stocking up on nutrients to prepare for the upstream swim...
Just like the salmon of Tomakomai Port!"
